subtheme: Teaching robots to see and act from images

subsubthemes.name: Building the core vision-language-action model
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that design, scale, and improve the fundamental architecture of models that connect what robots see to what actions they should take.

subsubthemes.name: Learning from past robot experiences and memories
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that help robots remember and reuse what they have done before, retrieving similar past experiences to guide new tasks.

subsubthemes.name: Learning from video and prediction
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that teach robots by watching videos or building internal models that predict what happens next, then using those predictions to decide actions.

subsubthemes.name: Understanding scene structure and spatial reasoning
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that help robots understand the layout and structure of scenes—where objects are, how they fit together, and what actions they afford—for better planning.

subsubthemes.name: Reasoning about action consequences and planning
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that teach robots to think through the consequences of their actions before executing them, using reasoning steps to improve decisions.

subsubthemes.name: Adapting to new robots and environments
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that help models trained on one robot or environment work on different robots or in new situations, often using minimal additional data.

subsubthemes.name: Making inference fast and efficient
subsubthemes.gist: Papers that reduce the computational cost of running vision-language models on robots, through pruning, quantization, or faster decoding methods.
